subject: Request: LaunchPad cohort credit escrow & top-up for Cloud Launch
messages:
From: Rebecca Cole <partners@launchpad.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: cloudbazaar-marketplace@cloudbazaar.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: LaunchPad cohort credit pool for Cloud Launch (intro + ask)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick product walkthrough last week — the technical fit looks great. LaunchPad is booking a 12-week Cloud Launch cohort starting April 2 and we'd like Redwood to be the preferred inference partner for the generative demos.

Two asks to move forward:
- Can Redwood allocate an initial cohort credit pool of $60k USD in marketplace/promotional credits scoped to cohort projects (approx. 15 teams)?
- We need a formal escrow/redemption flow so credits are consumed via CloudBazaar marketplace SKUs (so teams onboard and usage is tracked).

I attached a short cohort agreement and an onboarding sheet that lists expected project templates. Our internal deadline for partner confirmations is Mar 1.

Appreciate any constraints on cadence or approvals we should know about.

Cheers,
Rebecca
LaunchPad Accelerator
partners@launchpad.io

Attachments: launchpad_cohort_agreement.pdf (PDF, 120KB); accelerator_onboarding_sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rebecca Cole <partners@launchpad.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit pool for Cloud Launch (intro + ask)

Hi Rebecca — great to see the scope.

We can absolutely support a partner credit arrangement routed through CloudBazaar, but a few internal checkpoints:
1) Credit sizing: $60k is reasonable at the cohort level; we'll need to confirm whether this is considered promotional (marketing budget) or partnership (co-sell budget) for accounting.
2) Escrow/redemption: our marketplace ops require a simple mapping (partner SKU + cohort tag) and a signed intake form. CloudBazaar ops will actually issue the vouchers.
3) Security/usage: we'll need confirmation that no cohort project will run with customer PII; if any regulated data is expected we must require Private deployment or dedicated capacity.

Looping in Vivek and Ben to coordinate approvals and billing flow. Can you confirm the internal contact at CloudBazaar who will accept the escrow mapping? Also — do you expect cohort teams to ramp immediately or phase in over the 12 weeks?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Partner Growth, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: LaunchPad cohort credit pool for Cloud Launch — approval checklist

Monica/Ben — quick internal note:

I reviewed the ask and recommend approval subject to the following fast checks:
- Confirm marketing vs partner budget split (I lean 70/30 partner-marketing if LaunchPad promotes Redwood directly).
- CloudBazaar escrow flow: need a contact and a sample redemption payload (i.e., SKU + cohort_tag + spend_limit).
- Procurement / legal: SOW looks standard but ask Legal to confirm indemnity clause around demos (I can escalate if needed).

If all of the above are green, we can commit $60k. If Legal suggests changes that delay: propose a $35k staged commitment to start cohorts while we finish the full agreement.

Ben — could you confirm a simple billing construct (promo voucher issuance vs invoice credit) and how quickly Marketplace can activate vouchers after we submit the intake?

—Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit pool for Cloud Launch — approval checklist

All,

Marketplace ops (CloudBazaar) supports two paths: 1) Promo voucher issuance tied to a partner SKU (fastest, vouchers go live within 48-72 hours after intake) or 2) Invoice credit which requires cross-org AR mapping (5-7 business days). For a cohort that starts Apr 2, voucher issuance is the cleaner path.

We can do staged issuance: issue $25k in vouchers upfront, then a follow-on $35k top-up pending legal sign-off. I can create the intake ticket once LaunchPad confirms the CloudBazaar contact.

Also flagged the legal team about the SOW; Laura, can you pick this up and advise if the demo indemnity clause needs redlines?

-Ben
From: Rebecca Cole <partners@launchpad.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: cloudbazaar-marketplace@cloudbazaar.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchPad cohort credit pool for Cloud Launch — next steps and CloudBazaar contact

Thanks team — quick answers below and next steps:

- CloudBazaar contact: marketplace-ops@cloudbazaar.com (cc'd). They confirmed they can accept the partner SKU + cohort_tag mapping.
- Cohort ramp: teams tend to onboard in week 1-3; recommend staged vouchers.
- Legal: LaunchPad is fine with a demo indemnity carve-out; we can accept redlines on that paragraph.

Proposed flow:
1) Redwood issues $25k voucher batch to CloudBazaar markup tag LP-APR-28 (activate within 72 hours).
2) Legal finalizes SOW redlines by Feb 28; upon sign-off Redwood issues the remaining $35k.

If that works, Monica — Ben can you open the issuance ticket and let us know what payload you need from LaunchPad (cohort_tag, redemption window, team limit).

Best,
Rebecca
LaunchPad Accelerator
